verdict.summary: Round 4 remains clean. The dispatch-only sccache harness is default-off, every enabling or credential-export step carries the exact input guard, the cache namespace binds the toolchain, lockfile, and feature set, and automatic merge-queue runs retain the prior compiler invocation without a wrapper. The structural suite is non-vacuous, includes a targeted credential-guard mutation check, and all 14 posture tests pass. The research note accurately distinguishes a runnable experiment from adoption or measured results.
